name: Echo Debt Ledger
summary: Every victory is financed by consequences you have not paid yet.
description: A ledger-based system that converts borrowed power into delayed liabilities. It lets you overdraw resources for short-term spikes, then forces repayment as debuffs, lost options, or narrative complications. Mastery is learning how to schedule debt, hide it, or weaponize it against others.
coreLoop: Overdraw a resource (HP, mana, gold, cooldown time) to gain a strong immediate advantage.
Record an Echo Debt entry with a clear trigger (next combat, next rest, next travel).
Repay debt by accepting a penalty or performing a compensating action.
Refactor debts into bundled clauses to reduce severity or redirect payment.
progression: Unlock Debt Routing: shift repayment from self to environment (offerings, sacrifices, contracts).
Unlock Ledger Forgery: rewrite triggers and amounts at the cost of adding hidden interest.
Unlock Debt Execution: force enemies to inherit debt when they take your stolen power.
narrativeHooks: Receipts appear in places they should not: on mirrors, under armor plates, inside prayer books.
Collectors (human or not) recognize your signature and bargain for your future failures.
The world subtly favors you, then swings back harder when repayment comes due.
questHooks: Find the Missing Page that removes interest from one category of debt.
Negotiate with a Collector to refinance your ledger into a single catastrophic clause.
Track down a forger who can erase a debt entry without telling you what they took instead.

name: Neon Covenant
summary: You swear to the city, and the city rewrites the rules around you.
description: An urban authority that binds you to a living metropolis: neon signage, surveillance spirits, and infrastructural magic. You gain permissions (fast travel, safehouses, market access) in exchange for service (enforcement, sabotage, arbitration). The covenant grows stronger as the city trusts you, but it never forgets betrayal.
coreLoop: Accept a civic mandate (patrol, investigate, escort, disrupt).
Earn Standing with districts and guilds by completing mandates cleanly.
Spend Standing to invoke Authority perks (priority healing, blocked warrants, market access).
Manage Covenant Tension when you break rules or favor rival districts.
progression: Unlock District Keys: district-specific bonuses and hidden routes.
Unlock Writ of Override: cancel one hostile effect per combat if in-city.
Unlock Citywide Edict: set a temporary law that buffs allies and nerfs a tagged enemy type.
narrativeHooks: Streetlights flicker in your wake when you are angry or injured.
An unseen civic AI addresses you by rank, not name, and expects obedience.
Your reputation can literally change how crowds part and doors open.
questHooks: Expose a counterfeit district key ringed with cursed neon ink.
Stop a blackout ritual that would erase an entire district from the covenant map.
Choose between two districts whose laws conflict, and live with the permanent consequence.

name: Gravemind Compiler
summary: You do not learn skills. You compile them from the dead.
description: A cold framework that treats abilities as code artifacts. You harvest fragments from enemies and environments, then compile them into stable skills through constraints and tests. Power comes from engineering: naming, modularizing, and optimizing your build.
coreLoop: Harvest an ability fragment (a keyword, a damage pattern, a status interaction).
Choose a compiler target (new skill, upgrade, passive trait).
Pass constraints (resource budget, cooldown budget, tag compatibility).
Compile and run: accept a risk of bugs that must be fixed by field testing.
progression: Unlock Unit Tests: reduce bug chance by meeting preconditions before compilation.
Unlock Hot Patching: rewrite a compiled skill mid-run at increased resource cost.
Unlock Optimization Pass: permanently reduce cost/cooldown for a stable skill family.
narrativeHooks: Runes appear as build logs, and you start hearing errors as whispers.
Other system users call you a heretic because you refuse the natural skill tree.
Your failures are documented; your victories are reproducible.
questHooks: Recover a forbidden library of compiler directives from an abandoned lab-temple.
Defeat a rival compiler who weaponizes unstable builds with catastrophic bugs.
Fix a corrupted core module that causes all compiled skills to drift over time.

name: Liminal Cartographer
summary: You map the seams of reality and step through them.
description: A traveler path that reveals hidden edges: doorways between districts, cracks in dungeon walls, short routes through dreamspace. Your power scales with exploration and annotation, turning knowledge into mobility and ambush control. The more you map, the more the world tries to mislead you.
coreLoop: Discover liminal seams during travel, combat repositioning, or narrative events.
Mark seams on an internal map and assign them tags (safe, hostile, unstable).
Spend map charges to blink, flank, or escape to a previously marked seam.
Maintain map integrity by updating entries when the world shifts.
progression: Unlock Anchor Pins: stabilize one seam permanently in each biome.
Unlock Fold Steps: chain short teleports with escalating cost to bypass hazards.
Unlock Atlas Authority: impose map rules that debuff enemies in mapped territory.
narrativeHooks: Your map writes back, adding notes you did not remember making.
You begin to recognize places that should be impossible to reach twice.
Enemies who hunt you start tearing down doors and sealing alleys out of fear.
questHooks: Chart a forbidden shortcut through a collapsing sub-dimension before it closes.
Recover a stolen atlas page that contains your most dangerous seam.
Defeat a seam-eater that erases maps and memories of travel.

name: Flux Mirror Protocol
summary: The world hits you, and you return a cleaner copy back to it.
description: A defensive system that captures incoming effects as mirror samples and reflects a curated portion outward. It rewards patience and timing: soak a hit, refine the sample, then return it with interest. The protocol can also mirror your own buffs to allies at reduced potency.
coreLoop: Capture an incoming hit or debuff as a mirror sample.
Refine the sample into one of three outputs (reflect damage, reflect status, mirror buff).
Choose a target and apply the reflected output with controlled scaling.
Balance heat: excessive mirroring causes protocol instability and self-stun windows.
progression: Unlock Sample Compression: store multiple small samples for one big reflection.
Unlock Mirror Split: reflect to multiple targets with reduced magnitude.
Unlock Protocol Purge: delete harmful samples to cleanse yourself.
narrativeHooks: Your eyes briefly become reflective glass when you capture a sample.
Enemies start testing you with weak attacks to probe the mirror rules.
A mirror cult believes you are proof that reality can be edited safely.
questHooks: Retrieve an ancient mirror core that reduces instability heat generation.
Survive an arena designed to overwhelm the protocol and learn its hidden limits.
Hunt a copycat mirror user who reflects innocent bystanders instead of enemies.

name: Soulbound Exchange
summary: Trade memories, emotions, and fate as if they were currency.
description: A market framework that converts intangible life fragments into negotiable tokens. You can buy power, information, and protection at the cost of losing parts of yourself. The exchange is never evil by default; it is transactional and brutally honest.
coreLoop: Acquire exchange tokens (memories, vows, regrets) through choices and sacrifices.
Offer tokens to vendors, spirits, or the exchange itself for boons.
Track identity integrity: too many trades distort your personality and relationships.
Recover lost fragments through quests, bargains, or defeating token hoarders.
progression: Unlock Token Indexing: preview the long-term cost before a trade.
Unlock Arbitrage: profit by trading between factions that value different fragments.
Unlock Soul Escrow: delay payment and attach conditions to trades.
narrativeHooks: NPCs sometimes remember you differently after a major trade.
Your own narrative voice changes when an emotion token is sold.
Collectors recognize rare fragments and try to buy you out.
questHooks: Recover a sold childhood memory before it is burned as fuel in a ritual.
Shut down a predatory exchange booth that targets desperate refugees.
Negotiate a contract that buys back your name without paying in blood.

name: Null Gate Warden
summary: You are the lock on the door the void keeps trying to open.
description: An authority tied to gates and thresholds: portals, seals, summoning circles, and forbidden doors. You gain control over access and denial, making you lethal in positioning fights and unbeatable at containment. The void responds by escalating intrusion attempts and offering bribes.
coreLoop: Sense gates and bindings in the environment (including enemy rituals).
Spend Warden Charges to lock, unlock, or reroute a gate effect.
Mark targets with a threshold tag to amplify control effects.
Maintain Seal Integrity by completing containment tasks after combat.
progression: Unlock Gate Theft: steal an enemy teleport and reuse it once.
Unlock Seal Lattice: create a temporary arena that prevents escape.
Unlock Null Verdict: cancel one summoned entity or persistent effect per encounter.
narrativeHooks: You hear hinges where others hear silence.
Cultists treat you as the enemy of their cosmology and hunt you relentlessly.
Some doors open for you without permission, as if afraid to refuse.
questHooks: Rebuild a shattered seal network under a district before an invasion.
Destroy a gate key artifact that keeps respawning in different hands.
Decide whether to seal a portal permanently at the cost of trapping allies.

name: Kinetic Dividend
summary: Motion pays you back. Stillness charges you interest.
description: A movement path that turns travel, dodges, and repositioning into a renewable resource. It rewards active play: chaining steps, maintaining momentum, and choosing routes that maximize flow. In exchange, it punishes camping and repetitive loops with fatigue.
coreLoop: Accumulate Momentum by moving, dodging, or changing stance/target.
Spend Momentum to boost damage, reduce cooldowns, or negate one hit.
Avoid Momentum Decay by keeping actions varied across turns.
Cash out dividends at checkpoints for long-term buffs.
progression: Unlock Momentum Conversion: turn Momentum into mana or rage/chi equivalents.
Unlock Slipstream: allies gain a smaller Momentum bonus when you chain moves.
Unlock Breakpoint: once per fight, spend all Momentum for a huge tempo swing.
narrativeHooks: Your footsteps sound like coins hitting glass when Momentum peaks.
You start noticing paths that feel profitable and routes that feel cursed.
Enemies learn to create sticky terrain and nets to bankrupt you.
questHooks: Win a chase across rooftops without losing Momentum to claim a speed relic.
Break a curse that taxes movement in an entire district.
Defeat a rival runner who steals Momentum from others mid-combat.

name: Mnemonic Forge
summary: You craft gear from what you remember and sharpen it with what you regret.
description: A crafting-centric system that uses memory shards as reagents. It creates equipment that is mechanically real but narratively personal, gaining bonuses when used in situations tied to its origin. The forge is strongest when you face the same kind of threat that created the memory.
coreLoop: Extract a Memory Shard after major events (bosses, deaths, betrayals).
Choose a forge pattern (weapon, armor, accessory) and embed a shard.
Assign a Trigger Scene that grants a bonus when conditions match.
Temper the item by repeating the trigger scene or confronting its source.
progression: Unlock Dual Sharding: embed two shards for hybrid bonuses and risks.
Unlock Memory Annealing: reduce volatility and keep the best part of a shard.
Unlock Legacy Imprint: turn one forged item into a permanent blueprint.
narrativeHooks: Forged items speak in flashes: smells, sounds, and split-second visions.
People who recognize the memory behind an item react with fear or reverence.
Enemies can try to taint your shards by forcing traumatic outcomes.
questHooks: Find a smith who can stabilize a shard that keeps corrupting your gear.
Retrieve a stolen memory blade forged from someone else's life.
Surrender a shard temporarily to learn who else is collecting them.

name: Oath of the Glass Throne
summary: Speak commands that become true, but every lie cuts you back.
description: A command authority that turns declared oaths into temporary laws. You can issue short edicts like "No one bleeds here" or "Steel cannot break". The throne is merciless: breaking your own edict causes backlash and public loss of authority.
coreLoop: Declare an Oath (a short rule with a scope and duration).
Pay an Authority Cost (resources, cooldown lock, or a vow constraint).
Benefit while the rule holds, shaping combat and negotiation.
Resolve backlash if the oath is violated by you or exploited by enemies.
progression: Unlock Narrow Edicts: smaller scope for cheaper cost and fewer loopholes.
Unlock Crown Glass: convert backlash into a shield instead of damage.
Unlock Sovereign Clause: one per day, issue a rule that persists across scenes.
narrativeHooks: Your words leave hairline fractures in the air when they become law.
Rivals bait you into oaths they can exploit.
Supporters repeat your edicts as prayers, strengthening them.
questHooks: Recover the throne's missing seal that prevents others from counter-oathing you.
Defeat an oathbreaker who spreads loopholes as a weapon.
Choose which vow you will never break again to gain a permanent boon.

name: Anomaly Shepherd
summary: You do not destroy anomalies. You keep them and make them useful.
description: A containment framework that treats strange events and cursed artifacts as manageable assets. You capture anomalies, assign them handling protocols, then deploy them for controlled effects. Power scales with how well you keep them from escaping or eating your run.
coreLoop: Identify an anomaly (artifact, zone glitch, enemy mutation).
Contain it with a protocol (rules, sacrifices, or environmental conditions).
Deploy it for a limited effect window.
Repair containment and reduce breach risk between encounters.
progression: Unlock Multi-Containment: manage two anomalies at once with shared risk.
Unlock Protocol Automation: reduce maintenance actions by upgrading rules.
Unlock Shepherd's Bargain: negotiate directly with a sentient anomaly.
narrativeHooks: Your inventory feels heavier even when empty, like it is holding unsaid rules.
NPCs with sense magic avoid you, citing protocol noise.
Breach events create memorable disasters and rare opportunities.
questHooks: Recover a lost protocol manual that makes one anomaly family safe.
Stop a breach cascade triggered by a rival shepherd.
Decide whether to destroy an anomaly that has become emotionally attached to you.

name: Bloodline Refactor
summary: Your ancestry is editable, but every edit has a cost.
description: A lineage-editing system that lets you swap, splice, or suppress inherited traits. It is less about raw power and more about build control: adjust resistances, shift stat biases, and unlock hybrid synergies. Each refactor leaves scarring that enemies can exploit if they learn your pattern.
coreLoop: Acquire gene/essence samples from beasts, demons, or relic blood.
Spend Refactor Points to change one trait (swap, splice, suppress).
Stabilize changes through repeated usage or purification rituals.
Manage scarring: a negative tag that grows if you refactor too frequently.
progression: Unlock Safe Slots: a small number of reversible edits.
Unlock Hybrid Nodes: combine two traits into a new passive.
Unlock Bloodline Rewrite: once per arc, rebuild your trait map from scratch.
narrativeHooks: Your reflection shifts subtly after each refactor, like it is catching up.
Blood hunters can smell unstable edits and track you.
Allies may fear you if your lineage becomes too unnatural.
questHooks: Find a stabilizer catalyst that removes scarring for one refactor cycle.
Defeat a lineage tyrant who forces refactors onto unwilling subjects.
Recover the original blueprint of your bloodline to unlock hidden traits.

name: Chorus of Many Hands
summary: You are a party, even when you are alone.
description: A system that manifests semi-autonomous echoes of your past choices as "Hands". Each Hand performs small actions: loot, parry, chant, scout, or stabilize. You become strong by orchestration, not spam, and weakness comes from losing rhythm or overloading your chorus.
coreLoop: Earn Hand Slots by surviving arcs without collapsing your narrative.
Assign roles to Hands (support, control, utility).
Trigger chorus patterns by chaining actions across turns.
Reset the chorus when a pattern breaks or a Hand is destroyed.
progression: Unlock Specialized Hands: each with one unique reaction effect.
Unlock Polyphony: run two patterns simultaneously with a penalty.
Unlock Conductor State: temporarily take direct control of all Hands for a burst turn.
narrativeHooks: Hands argue in your peripheral vision when you hesitate.
NPCs sometimes notice you speaking to no one and back away.
Certain enemies can silence parts of your chorus, forcing adaptation.
questHooks: Recover a memory-lens that increases Hand reliability in chaos zones.
Defeat a conductor who steals Hands to build their own chorus.
Restore the rhythm of a broken district where sound magic has collapsed.

name: Spectral Arbitration
summary: You enforce contracts between the living and the dead.
description: An authority built on rules that persist past death. You can bind spirits, settle debts, and punish oathbreakers by invoking spectral clauses. The arbitration is strongest when you have evidence: names, signatures, relics, or witnessed betrayals.
coreLoop: Collect evidence of a promise, debt, or betrayal.
Invoke a clause to bind a target to repayment or restriction.
Use arbitration powers to compel truth, block escape, or extract a toll.
Close the case to gain lasting Authority rank and reduce backlash.
progression: Unlock Writ of Witness: record one event and treat it as perfect evidence later.
Unlock Clause Chains: stack multiple small bindings instead of one large one.
Unlock Judgment Day: once per arc, enforce a mass clause on a faction.
narrativeHooks: Ghosts appear as court scribes, quietly noting everything you do.
Some villains refuse to speak their real names to avoid jurisdiction.
Your justice can be feared if you enforce it too literally.
questHooks: Prove a centuries-old betrayal with a missing witness shard.
Arbitrate a feud between two undead houses before it becomes war.
Decide whether to pardon an oathbreaker to gain a greater future clause.

name: Stormwire Circuit
summary: Conduct lightning through allies, enemies, and terrain like a living circuit.
description: A path that turns positioning into electrical logic. You place nodes through movement, hits, or marks, then discharge through the network for chain effects. It rewards tactical play and punishes sloppy spacing.
coreLoop: Place nodes on targets or tiles via attacks, dodges, or skill tags.
Complete a circuit by linking at least three nodes.
Discharge to deal chain damage, apply stuns, or recharge resources.
Manage overload: too many circuits cause self-shock penalties.
progression: Unlock Insulated Steps: reduce overload and make circuits safer.
Unlock Split Discharge: choose between damage, control, or sustain outputs.
Unlock Storm Crown: while a circuit is active, gain speed and crit bonuses.
narrativeHooks: Your hair and cloak lift as if underwater when circuits form.
Storm spirits treat you like a conductor and demand offerings.
Enemies learn to break your circuit by forcing repositioning.
questHooks: Recover a storm capacitor that increases node range.
Defeat a lightning beast whose body is a natural circuit map.
Stabilize a stormwire relay tower before it fries a district.

name: Quietus Resonance
summary: Silence is a weapon that grows sharper the longer it lasts.
description: A suppression framework that thrives on the absence of noise: spellcasting, alarms, and overt aggression. You build Resonance by denying enemy actions and maintaining stealth. At peak resonance, you can mute entire mechanics for a short window.
coreLoop: Accumulate Resonance by applying silence, fear, or disruption effects.
Spend Resonance to reduce enemy accuracy, block magic, or extend stealth.
Maintain Quiet: loud actions drain Resonance unless you pay a cost.
Cash out Resonance for a decisive mute window in key fights.
progression: Unlock Silent Cast: cast one spell without breaking Quiet.
Unlock Echo Cancel: once per combat, cancel an enemy skill activation.
Unlock Domain of Stillness: create a zone where cooldowns tick slower for enemies.
narrativeHooks: You start hearing the world in layers and can tell when a lie is loud.
Certain enemies become paranoid because their spells keep failing near you.
Your presence is described as too quiet even when you are visible.
questHooks: Seal a bell-tower artifact that makes stealth impossible in a region.
Steal a tome from a choir of mages who weaponize sound magic.
Choose whether to save an ally or preserve Quiet to stop a ritual.

name: Prism Rebirth Kernel
summary: Every reset refracts you into a cleaner, stranger version of yourself.
description: A rebirth system that offers controlled resets at chosen thresholds rather than only on death. Each rebirth refracts your build into a prism of aspects (offense, defense, utility, fate) that can be rebalanced. Rebirth is powerful but destabilizing if abused.
coreLoop: Reach a rebirth threshold (level, quest arc, defeat, or ritual).
Select a prism refraction: redistribute stats and unlock a kernel perk.
Pay a rebirth cost (lost items, locked skills, or narrative debt).
Stabilize the new self through use and repeated choices.
progression: Unlock Color Lock: keep one aspect unchanged through rebirth.
Unlock Kernel Memory: retain one skill upgrade path across resets.
Unlock True Rebirth: reset a major system constraint once per season.
narrativeHooks: People who knew you before feel like they are speaking to a version of you.
Your aura shifts color during major decisions.
Some factions hunt reborn users because they disrupt prophecy.
questHooks: Recover a prism lens that lets you preview rebirth outcomes.
Stop a cult that forces involuntary rebirths to erase identities.
Perform a rebirth inside a cursed zone to purge a persistent debuff.

name: Dungeon Seed Sovereignty
summary: Claim a place, grow it, and let it fight for you.
description: An authority that binds you to a territory seed. You can cultivate rooms, hazards, and guardians, turning a location into a strategic asset. In return, your power is partially tied to the health and secrecy of your dungeon seed.
coreLoop: Plant a seed in a location and define its theme (ruins, neon, wilds, void).
Earn growth by feeding the seed loot, mana, or captured anomalies.
Deploy dungeon perks (traps, buffs, safe rest, crafting benches) when in-territory.
Defend the seed from raids and corruption attempts.
progression: Unlock Room Specialization: build focused rooms that boost specific systems.
Unlock Guardian Binding: bind an enemy as a reusable defender.
Unlock Sovereign Rule: impose one strong local law inside your territory.
narrativeHooks: Your territory begins to feel alive, protective, and hungry for growth.
Rivals track you by the subtle signature of your dungeon theme.
Allies may disagree with how your territory feeds itself.
questHooks: Steal an enemy seed core to prevent a hostile dungeon bloom.
Cleanse a corruption that turns your territory against you.
Negotiate with a city authority about whether your seed is legal.

name: Vorpal Etiquette
summary: Politeness is a blade. Social rules become combat rules.
description: A social-combat path that turns conversation structures into mechanical advantages. You can parry with compliments, riposte with truths, and duel with formal challenges that constrain both parties. It is strongest in cities and courts, but still useful as battlefield taunts and morale control.
coreLoop: Identify the current social frame (threat, bargain, duel, apology).
Choose an etiquette move to gain advantage (initiative, crit, debuff, escape).
Accumulate Poise by maintaining consistent tone and not breaking your own rules.
Spend Poise to force a formal constraint on an enemy for a short window.
progression: Unlock Counter-Rumor: remove one debuff by reframing the narrative.
Unlock Formal Challenge: force a single-target duel that boosts your accuracy.
Unlock Court Immunity: reduce penalties from intimidation and fear effects.
narrativeHooks: People remember your words with painful clarity.
Enemies who mock etiquette often find themselves trapped by their own boasts.
Your reputation becomes a weapon others try to steal or ruin.
questHooks: Win a duel of words to avoid a war between two factions.
Expose a liar whose rumors are mechanically weakening a district.
Earn a title that grants permanent Poise generation in negotiations.

name: Star-Eater Clause
summary: Grow by consuming what should never be consumed: laws, light, and luck.
description: A high-risk framework centered on devouring abstract resources. You can consume buffs, titles, and rare drops to gain permanent micro-bonuses or unlock mutations. The clause demands restraint: overconsumption attracts predators and increases self-corruption.
coreLoop: Select a target to consume (a buff, a token, a rare item, a rule fragment).
Gain an immediate surge and a small permanent mutation.
Accrue Corruption and attract attention from cosmic predators.
Purge or stabilize corruption through rituals, sacrifices, or containment quests.
progression: Unlock Selective Digestion: keep the good part, discard the poison.
Unlock Predation Immunity: reduce the chance of being hunted after consumption.
Unlock Law Devour: consume a temporary rule to gain a one-fight rewrite power.
narrativeHooks: Your shadow looks heavier than it should, like it contains swallowed light.
Fortune becomes inconsistent around you: lucky streaks, then brutal corrections.
Some allies fear you will eat their blessings by proximity.
questHooks: Survive a hunt from a star-eater that claims you stole its clause.
Find a purifier that turns corruption into craftable catalysts.
Choose a permanent taboo: something you will never consume again for stability.
